title: fix(mechanic): 8 uses deny rules read their * literally on claude-code 2.1.330
description:
## .what

claude-code 2.1.330 warns at session start that 8 deny rules, generated from role=mechanic into each actor's settings, read their `*` literally. a rule that mixes a mid-pattern `*` with the `:*` suffix is matched as a literal prefix, so it likely never matches.

## .the rules

- `Bash(rhx git.branch.uses --org * allow:*)`
- `Bash(rhx git.branch.uses --org * del:*)`
- `Bash(rhx git.commit.uses --org * allow:*)`
- `Bash(rhx git.commit.uses --org * del:*)`
- `Bash(npx rhachet run --skill git.branch.uses --org * allow:*)`
- `Bash(npx rhachet run --skill git.branch.uses --org * del:*)`
- `Bash(npx rhachet run --skill git.commit.uses --org * allow:*)`
- `Bash(npx rhachet run --skill git.commit.uses --org * del:*)`

## .the harm

these rules stop a clone that grants itself commit or branch quota for an org. while they never match, that gate is open.

the 2.1.282 release notes say mid-pattern `:*` rules were skipped in settings files before that version. so the gap likely predates 2.1.330; this is read from the notes, not probed.

## .the fix

in the mechanic role's settings source: `allow:*` -> `allow*`, `del:*` -> `del*` (the cli's own suggestion).

also flagged by the same cli, seen in one session on 2.1.330: `Write(.route/**)` in allow is ignored by file checks; the cli asks for `Edit(.route/**)`.

## .the clamp

an enrolled clone on claude-code 2.1.330 starts with zero `Deny rule` / `Permission allow rule` warnings, and `rhx git.commit.uses --org <org> allow` from a clone is denied.

## .source

first seen in uladkasach/dev-env-setup, 2026-11-23, at session start.
